_meta.notes: Clerk online-system printout (summary_printer.cfm?ID=653) headed 'Summary'; the form's own Report line reads '2012 Summary Report (Year End)', matching the clerk listing. Column A is machine-printed; BOTH YTD cells were left blank by the system and filled in BY HAND with the SAME figure, $488,558.50, for contributions-to-date and expenditures-to-date. That equality is implausible but is what the document shows - recorded verbatim, not reconciled. The Other-Campaign-Accounts columns print $0.00. No checkbox block/amendment question/signature block, so those fields are null; report_date is the system print date. Line 3 ($89,534.60) matches line 7 of the October interim report and Column A arithmetic is consistent (ending balance $0.00).

contributions.detail: exact (20,350.00 = 20,350.00). 24 lines sum to 20350.00, equal to the table's own printed 'Total Contributions $20,350.00' and to the page-1 Summary 'Total this Period' for line 1.

expenditures.detail: exact (109,884.60 = 109,884.60). 13 lines (12 on p2 + 1 on p3) sum to 109884.60, equal to the printed 'Total Expenditures $109,884.60' on p3 and the page-1 Summary line 2.

itemized.page_subtotal_gates: This variant prints NO per-page SUBTOTAL row - only one grand Total per table. Contributions: 24 rows on p2 = printed 'Total Contributions $20,350.00' - GATE PASSES. Expenditures: the table SPANS p2 and p3 (12 rows + 1 row); 13 rows = printed 'Total Expenditures $109,884.60' on p3 - GATE PASSES. Had p3 not been rendered the expenditures side would have been short by $3,056.40, which is exactly the failure mode the render-every-page rule exists for.
itemized.escalation_note: Base read at 220 dpi. The page-3 expenditure row + Total was first cropped too narrow and cut the Amount column off the right edge ('$10...'); re-cropped wider to recover $3,056.40 and $109,884.60. pdftotext returns nothing for this PDF - it is an image-only scan of a web print, so every figure is vision-read. Row bands taken from the table's own printed horizontal rules (detected by a full-width dark-pixel scan), so geometry follows the grid rather than the text.
itemized.notes: Crockett, Mark - '2012 Summary Report (Year End)', Salt Lake County Clerk Election Division web-print variant (footer http://slcintranet/financialDisclosure/clerk/summary_printer.cfm?ID=653, printed 1/14/2013), NOT the hand-filled paper form. Office Sought Mayor, REPUBLICAN, Org Type 'Personal Campaign Committee'. Pages are numbered 'Page N of 3' in the header. The Address/City/State/Zip row and the Phone/Fax/Email row on p1 are covered by solid black county REDACTION bars. On p1 the two printed YTD cells are overwritten IN HANDWRITING with the SAME figure on both lines - '488,558.50' for contributions AND for expenditures - the known Column-B-unreliable pattern; the typed 'Total this Period' figures ($20,350.00 / $109,884.60) are the ones that reconcile and are used here. Line 7 Balance at Close prints $0.00 although line 5 subtotal ($109,884.60) minus line 6 ($109,884.60) is indeed 0. Contributions carry an explicit Type column (Individual 20 / Organization 4) and an In-Kind? column that is EMPTY on every row of both tables. The expenditures table breaks across pages 2 and 3.
